scenes.title: The updated workflow.
scenes.takeaway: CR-V13, CR-V14 and CR-V15.
scenes.narration: Patrick, this walkthrough shows the current vehicle first workflow and the latest barcode integrity changes. We will also check the console updates and one remaining record control issue.

scenes.title: Vehicle first.
scenes.takeaway: Scan-ready. Tap the field only to type.
scenes.narration: Step one is the vehicle barcode. The field opens in scan mode, with keyboard input suppressed. Tapping the field enables typing and marks the entry as manual. There is no separate manual entry button.

scenes.title: Driver second.
scenes.takeaway: Then direction, review and submit.
scenes.narration: Step two is the driver employee number. This field also opens scan ready. After the driver, choose the direction, then review and submit.

scenes.title: Letters are supported.
scenes.takeaway: AB123 stays AB123. Numeric IDs fold to E1003.
scenes.narration: Employee numbers can contain letters. Here, A B one two three identifies our demonstration driver. Numeric forms one zero zero three, E one zero zero three, and E M P dash one zero zero three all resolve to E one zero zero three.

scenes.title: Choose the direction.
scenes.takeaway: Vehicle IN or Vehicle OUT.
scenes.narration: With the vehicle and driver captured, choose Vehicle In or Vehicle Out. The next screen is the review step.

scenes.title: Review, then submit.
scenes.takeaway: Vehicle, driver, direction, gate and time.
scenes.narration: Choose the direction, then review the movement before submitting. The scanner returns to the start after recording it.

scenes.title: Unknown, scanned.
scenes.takeaway: No barcode warning. No Check barcode flag.
scenes.narration: This unknown barcode arrived through the scanner input path. It advances without the typed barcode warning. When submitted, its vehicle record is created without a Check barcode flag. Normal driver checks still apply.

scenes.title: Complete the barcode.
scenes.takeaway: G00 is incomplete. Enter all four digits.
scenes.narration: When typing is needed, tap the barcode field. That tap enables typing and records manual entry. A partial barcode such as G zero zero is refused. Enter all four digits.

scenes.title: Check a typed barcode.
scenes.takeaway: A complete unknown barcode can continue.
scenes.narration: A complete typed barcode that is not in inventory warns: Check this barcode. Continue if it is right. The movement can proceed, and the vehicle is marked Check barcode for supervisor review.

scenes.title: Visible for review.
scenes.takeaway: G9002 was typed. Its record says Check barcode.
scenes.narration: Here is the vehicle created from the typed unknown barcode. Check barcode is visible on its record. The unknown scanned vehicle was verified without that flag. That distinction is deliberate.

scenes.title: Review the exit.
scenes.takeaway: Inventory details do not block the movement.
scenes.narration: The scanned vehicle can leave through the normal driver and license checks. This is the exit review screen, before submission. Missing inventory details do not block the movement.

scenes.title: Role refusal verified.
scenes.takeaway: Scanner cannot approve. Fleet Lead or above is required.
scenes.narration: This is the actual role refusal. Casey Rowe holds the Scanner role and cannot approve the override. This driver has a current license but lacks authorization, so we are showing a role refusal, not an expired license screen.

scenes.title: Choose the duration.
scenes.takeaway: 9 Hours / 12 Hours / Today / 48 Hours / 3 Days
scenes.narration: Authorization is selectable. The choices are nine hours, twelve hours, today, forty eight hours, and three days. Nine hours is the default, not a fixed duration.

scenes.title: Supervisor Console.
scenes.takeaway: Vehicle inventory in the desktop console.
scenes.narration: This is the desktop supervisor console, showing vehicle inventory. Records open through their identifiers instead of separate per row Edit buttons.

scenes.title: Open the vehicle record.
scenes.takeaway: VIN opens the record. Removal control needs attention.
scenes.narration: A vehicle opens from its V I N, or Add V I N when missing. There is one remaining discrepancy: the intended removal button is still hidden inside this record in the current build. That control needs correction before we can demonstrate removal.

scenes.title: Add with only a VIN.
scenes.takeaway: Leave the optional barcode blank.
scenes.narration: Adding a vehicle requires only its V I N. Leave the optional barcode blank and save. The application assigns the next free G barcode.

scenes.title: Barcode assigned.
scenes.takeaway: The next free barcode is G0006 in this demo.
scenes.narration: The vehicle has been saved. Here the next free barcode was G zero zero zero six, and the inventory shows it beside the V I N we entered.

scenes.title: Open by user identity.
scenes.takeaway: User ID or name opens the existing record.
scenes.narration: In the user list, select the User I D or name to open that existing user. The old per row Edit and Remove controls are gone.

scenes.title: Edit the existing user.
scenes.takeaway: Scanner / Fleet Lead / Supervisor / Admin
scenes.narration: This is the existing user record. The available roles are Scanner, Fleet Lead, Supervisor, and Admin. These are prototype accounts, with the limitations shown in the form.

scenes.title: Open by Device ID.
scenes.takeaway: Select the identifier to inspect the device.
scenes.narration: Device records open from Device I D. The list retains operational status and history controls.

scenes.title: Device record.
scenes.takeaway: Location and device details together.
scenes.narration: The selected device opens here, with its location and configuration details.

scenes.title: Review the history.
scenes.takeaway: Searchable movements. Device-local review build.
scenes.narration: Movement history remains searchable. This is a device local review build. Shared cloud data and synchronization remain future work. The videos are ready for review, with deployment handled separately.
